# publish-watch

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Watches the daily Build and Publish workflow of equinai/pgbouncer-embedded on GitHub (GitHubEvents.Watch): a failed publish of the @equin/pgbouncer-* packages files a github-run-failed report — the next PgBouncer upgrade would have nothing to pin.
- Server:
  - Contributes: `github-events.watch` "equinai/pgbouncer-embedded build-and-publish.yml"
  - Uses: `integrations/github-events.GitHubEvents`
